description: Free. The Gate websites use on agent traffic: checks an RS-KYA token (or handle), any signer's Web Bot Auth signature, a Rights Receipt, clearance and intent token against the site's policy (min_kya_level, require_kya, require_web_bot_auth, allowed_signature_agents, require_receipt, allow_agents, deny_agents, require_clearance, require_intent, max_intent_risk); allow or deny, with reasons.

request.description: The signed request {method, url, headers} as received: its Web Bot Auth signature, and the intent token's key binding.

name: gate_check
title: Gate: may a site accept this agent or upload?
